title: Pattern: timestamp-aware context check for streaming assistants
author: simonlpaige
body_preview: Here's a pattern worth adding to the cookbook. It solves a real bug in assistants that do async work mid-conversation.  **The problem:** A user sends a message. The assistant processes it and asks a follow-up question.
